tvs.text-bl-seo-2:
• Maximum safety. We sterilize our instruments in three stages: disinfection with solutions, hot-air sterilization and UV light. Our core principle is guaranteed safety for the health of our clients and staff.
  • Every artist is an expert. You entrust your feet to professionals who will not only do quality work, but also help you relax and enjoy pleasant sensations.
  • All types of pedicure in one place. Our studio has everything it takes to offer clients a choice of different types of pedicure in Bucharest: classic, e-file and medical.
  • Excellent results. After the procedure, no thickened skin remains – only soft, smooth skin. For this, we use a professional softening and moisturizing cream.
  • We solve problems. Feet often suffer from ingrown nails, corns and calluses. Our artists know how to deal with each of these issues, so after your pedicure you'll feel guaranteed relief.
  • A pleasant atmosphere and an enjoyable process. Sit back, get comfortable and enjoy the sensations. While the artist works, you can doze off, rest, listen to music and more.

tvs.text_bl1_about:
A pedicure in Bucharest is especially relevant: in Romania's changeable climate, the skin of the feet is exposed to stress, and it's important to care not only for its softness but also for its health. The same goes for your nails.

Thickened skin prevents normal air exchange and also impairs signals to the nerve endings, of which there are so many in the soles of the feet. At the Lbar studio, our artists do pedicures for women and men, taking care not only of aesthetics but also of health.

We put a spring in every step! Come for a pedicure in Sector 1 and relax in the comfort of our studio, where every artist performs the procedure professionally and with care – all you have to do is enjoy it!
